scope.purpose: Trigger an action, or navigate to a task, from a compact square control that shows only an icon, with an accessible name that is never visible.
useCases: Toolbars, table rows and card headers where a recognizable icon is enough (close, more, edit, delete, copy).
Dense layouts beside Buttons of the same size, at the same height and with the same treatments (intent x appearance).
Navigation to a task with href (an icon-only link with a button appearance), like Button.
A pending action with loading, keeping the size and focus.
exclusions: Toggle buttons with a pressed state (bold, mute): SegmentedControl or a later toggle, like Button.
A visible tooltip: Tooltip (wave 3) is composed by the integration; no native title attribute.
Badges or counters over the icon (notification dots): a later indicator composition.
Round (circular) shape: corners follow radius.control of each brand, like Button.
Menu triggers with a chevron (Menu, wave 3).
alternatives: Button with a leading icon when space allows a visible label, which is always clearer.
Menu (wave 3) for a list of actions behind a single trigger.

fixtures: Phosphor glyphs re-exported by examples/icon/glyphs.ts for the examples and tests (fixtures, not dependencies).

contract.scope: IconButton contract: intent (accent, neutral, danger; default neutral), appearance (solid, outline, ghost; default ghost), size (sm, md, lg), required label as the accessible name only, href, disabled, loading; container, icon (exactly one Icon) and loadingIndicator parts; Button interaction states, precedence and activate event; Button tokens with a square box of size.control.{size}; thirteen rules.

decisionsTaken: Separate component rather than a Button option: an icon-only control has a different required anatomy (one icon, no visible label), a square box and a different default treatment; Button keeps its required visible label.

Same props, states, event, precedence and tokens as Button where they apply (intent, appearance, size, href, disabled, loading; color.action.*, radius.control, size.control.{size}, size.icon.{size}, focus roles, motion), so an IconButton matches a Button of the same size; no new token.

Default intent neutral and appearance ghost (Button: accent solid): icon buttons are mostly secondary actions in toolbars and rows, where a filled accent square is too loud. Confirmed by the user at the contract gate (2026-10-16, "Pareil pour le neutral+ghost par défaut sur le bouton icône").

label is required and only the accessible name, as in the catalog note ("IconButton needs an explicit accessible name"); no native title tooltip: it is not keyboard or touch accessible and would duplicate the future Tooltip.
The icon slot requires exactly one Icon (min 1, max 1) and the host's iconSize applies, as in Button slots (Icon contract rule).
Box: a square of size.control.{size} (32/40/48 px in standard density, following density like Button heights); the interaction target is extended to 44 px without enlarging the visible box.
The icon is centered by its box: the reference set draws its 1/8 inset symmetrically, so the box center is the drawing center and no optical compensation is needed.
Contrast checked on the same contrastScope as Button (six neutral backdrops, outline border on muted in dark informational, accepted at the Button contract gate).

User at the wave 1 Figma parity review (2026-10-26): "on expose la propriété Size des icônes dans les composants qui l'importent (genre badge) … la taille de l'icône ne devrait pas être modifiable dans ces composants mais décidée en amont et imposée dans le composant". The Figma master no longer nests the Icon component: the Phosphor glyph sits directly in the variants at the size the component imposes, behind an instance-swap property of the component; designers choose the glyph only. No code change (the code already imposes the size).

implementationNotes: Self-contained folder packages/svelte/src/components/icon-button/ on the Bits UI Button primitive (button or a with href), its own CSS duplicated from the Button patterns rather than importing Button: a component folder must stay copyable with tokens.css, Bits UI and its declared dependencies (icon).
Loading indicator: the same inline spinner as Button, sized at iconSize, replacing the icon in place.

Implemented: the ::before target is extended in both dimensions (Button extends only the width); the review glyphs added for the wave (x, dots-three, pencil-simple, copy, info, magnifying-glass, star) live in examples/icon-button/glyphs.ts so that the Icon review page stays unchanged.
